reason: Declarations in the assembly root that already had the resolve<Feature>/validate<Feature>/<feature>Port shape when ADR 0006 R2 landed. Each is a reviewed exception for the current tree, not a precedent: a new dedicated path must argue its own exception and remove the old one when it disappears.

symbols.name: hostMeditationPort
symbols.reason: Host-side send-session adapter: it binds the delivery face the send tool dispatches through beside the live-binding face a reflection resolves its targets against. The meditation section itself is resolved, judged and assembled in features/evolution/meditation (mount.go), so no feature resolver remains here.

symbols.name: hostGenerationPort
symbols.reason: Generation-scoped bind seam, not a feature resolver: it carries one method (bind(run *Run)) that hands a host-dialect consumer the run the assembly built before the first generation is published, so each candidate generation's builder installs its face where that generation's binding construction reads it. No feature name is dispatched here — every consumer mounts through the generic registry (ADR 0007) and this root never names one.
